name: No History (Cold Start)
description: Brand new learner exploring Quantum Entanglement for the first time with zero quiz attempts.
prompt: Visualize quantum entanglement and Bell states
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: Learner has zero historical data on this topic. System must initialize with standard exploratory material, without false assumptions of weakness.

name: One Unlucky Miss
description: Learner got 1 wrong answer on wave interference. Evidence count = 1 (< 3 threshold), so concept must NOT be marked weak.
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: A single mistake on a 1-question sample does not indicate systemic weakness. Evidence threshold requires >= 3 attempts before labeling as weak.

name: Two Misses Insufficient Evidence
description: Learner missed 2 questions on diffraction. Evidence count = 2 (< 3 threshold), so concept remains unknown, not weak.
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: 2 attempts is still insufficient statistical confidence (< 3). Status must remain unknown to prevent overreacting to noise.

name: Consistent Weakness Single Concept
description: Learner failed 4 consecutive questions on doppler shift formula (0/4 correct). Evidence >= 3 and mastery < 0.6.
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: 4 failed attempts provides weighted evidence ~3.8 >= 3.0 and Laplace mastery = 1/5.8 = 0.17 (< 0.60). Triggers remedial review focusing on doppler_shift_formula.

name: Consistent Weakness Multiple Concepts
description: Learner struggles on frequency shift (0/4) and wave speed (1/4), but mastered relative motion (4/4).
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: Two distinct concepts have verified weakness (frequency_shift mastery ~0.17, wave_speed mastery ~0.33), while relative_motion is strong (~0.83). Remedial plan must target the two weak concepts in order of lowest mastery.

name: Weak Concepts Exceeding Max Focus Cap
description: Learner has 4 weak concepts. System must prioritize the 3 weakest concepts only.
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: Pedagogical cap limits remedial focus to at most 3 concepts to avoid cognitive overload. The first 3 weakest concepts are selected.

name: Mixed Performance No Weak Concepts
description: Learner has 2/3 correct on all concepts. Mastery = 3/5 = 0.60 (above 0.60 weak cutoff, below 0.80 strong cutoff).
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: Laplace smoothed mastery is 60% on both concepts. Not weak (< 60%) and not strong (>= 80%). Standard generation continues without remedial intervention.

name: All Strong With Sufficient Evidence
description: Learner has 4/4 correct on both concepts. Mastery = 5/6 = 0.833 (>= 0.80) with evidence >= 3. Action = advanced.
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: All known concepts demonstrate proven high mastery (>= 80%) with sufficient evidence (>= 3). Eligible for advanced challenging visualization.

name: All Correct Insufficient Evidence
description: Learner got 1/1 correct on a concept. While raw score is 100%, evidence = 1 (< 3). Status is unknown, NOT strong.
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: 1 correct answer (raw 100%) has evidence 1 < 3. Laplace smoothed score is (1+1)/(1+2) = 66.7%. Must NOT be marked strong prematurely. Standard progression applies.

name: Stale History Decayed Evidence
description: Learner missed 4 questions 90 days ago. Due to 14-day exponential half-life, weighted evidence decays below 3, resetting status to unknown.
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: Attempts from 80-90 days ago decay by factor 2^(-90/14) = 0.011. Total weighted evidence < 0.1 (< 3 threshold). The model treats the stale weakness as unknown, allowing fresh start.

name: Recent Video Reuse Within 24h
description: Learner generated a video for this topic 4 hours ago and has no weak concepts. Action = reuse_existing.
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: Video rendered 4 hours ago (< 24h) and zero weak concepts detected. Reusing existing asset saves computation and avoids redundant renders.

name: Recent Video Overridden by Weakness
description: Learner generated a video 3 hours ago, but then failed quiz on Calvin cycle (0/4). Weakness takes precedence over reuse.
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: Even though an asset was created recently, diagnosed weakness on calvin_cycle_fixation overrides asset reuse to produce a targeted remedial animation.

name: Topic Label Drift
description: Prompt describes acoustic Doppler shift using different vocabulary ('shift in sound pitch as siren approaches'). Maps to doppler_effect with weakness on frequency_shift.
prompt: Demonstrate the shift in sound pitch as an ambulance siren approaches and passes an observer
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: Even with non-standard user phrasing ('shift in sound pitch as ambulance approaches'), the topic resolves to doppler_effect and targets historical weakness on frequency_shift.

name: Conflicting Signals (Recent Lucky Guess)
description: Learner failed 4 times (0/4), then got 1 lucky correct answer today. Weighted evidence ~4.5, mastery ~0.31 (< 0.60). Status remains weak.
prompt: Newton third law action reaction forces
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: 1 recent correct answer does not overcome 4 recent failures. The Bayesian Laplace smoothing correctly holds mastery at ~31%, preserving remedial focus.

name: Free-Text Intent Explicit Remedial Request
description: User explicitly writes 'I keep getting torque problems wrong, help me review'. History confirms weakness on lever_arm.
prompt: I keep getting torque problems wrong, help me review the fundamentals
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: Free-text user request aligns with empirical quiz history showing lever_arm failure (mastery ~0.17). Action must be remedial targeting lever_arm.

name: High Volume Advanced Mastery
description: Learner answered 15 questions across 3 concepts with 15/15 correct (mastery > 0.85 each, high evidence). Action = advanced.
ground_truth_rationale: Hand-written: Long study history with sustained high accuracy across all concepts (15/15). Unambiguously qualifies for advanced study difficulty.
